what: Plan forwards dropped slots to threshold only, but dropped reviewer outputs are omitted from dirty-tree recovery inputs
scenario_or_breakage: Under both-vendor --no-fallback, a Cursor static peer can fail and be dropped after writing a dirty-tree sidecar; dispatch-with-waterfall omits dropped outputs from ALL_OUTPUT_FILES, and review-core only calls recover_dirty_tree on the external/Claude arrays derived from that list, so the dropped peer's tracked or untracked mutations are never reverted
suggested_fix: Keep dropped outputs out of collection, but join DROPPED_SLOTS_FILE slot/tool records against PANEL_MANIFEST and pass existing dropped output dirty-tree sidecars through recovery before threshold; avoid changing the shared waterfall TSV unless necessary
